user.title: Add MQTT button
user.description: Listen to an MQTT topic and fire a button event whenever a matching message arrives.

data_description.topic: Topic to subscribe to. Wildcards (+ and #) are allowed.
data_description.value_template: Optional. Variables: value (raw payload), value_json (parsed JSON payload), topic. Return an event type (e.g. press, double_press) to fire it, true to fire the first event type, or anything else to ignore the message. Leave empty to treat every message as a press.
data_description.event_types: Event types this button can fire. The first one is used when the template returns true or when no template is set.
data_description.qos: MQTT quality of service used for the subscription.

error.no_event_types: At least one event type is required.
